name: Midori no Umi
source:
In the middle of the forest, there is a beautiful lake and a spacious western-style building where 12 people lived. They had all lost their memories and woke up to find themselves in this place. With many books in the library, instruments in the music room and absolutely no troubles, it is like a paradise for the residents. Even if they wanted to leave, they can’t because it is surrounded by a sea of trees and darkness. No one has been known to have successfully left. Then, one of the boys disappeared and Kai gradually remembers his past. He wants to find out why he is here, but is warned against doing so. What would happen if he regains his memories?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
森林深处有一座美丽的湖泊，湖畔宽敞的西式宅邸里住着12个人。他们都失去了记忆，醒来时已身处此地。图书室藏书丰富，音乐室乐器齐全，生活无忧，宛如乐园。即使想离开也无能为力，因为宅邸被树海与黑暗包围，从未有人成功逃离。后来，一名少年失踪，櫂也逐渐想起过去。他试图查明自己为何来到这里，却受到警告。若记忆全部恢复，等待他的会是什么？

[译自 [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
